title: UNPATCHED Kuldra Raid Fight SKIP
author: FastTipsGaming
description: In this video, I'll be showing you how to skip the Kuldra boss fight after the latest 1.0.1 patch in Runescape Dragonwilds.

transcript.text: Welcome to Fasti's Gaming. Today, I might actually have a world first for you guys. I haven't seen this anywhere
else on the internet, so I'll show you how to do the Coldra boss skip after the latest patch that took out our floating
stones. This is going to seem a bit familiar until it completely changes, so please pay attention.
This is not as easy as the skips that everyone's been used to in the past. So, with all that being said, let's get
right into it. Instead of using the leftmost platform to jump on, and because Jagex has
patched every freaking single rock I've tried to jump on, including the bridge itself, I decided to go pretty much down
the middle instead. You will need to learn how to do the infinite double jump exploit. I do have
a video on my channel that will teach you how to do it as well. Also, in case it isn't obvious, I am on
console, so I can guarantee that this does [music] work. You will need to practice and make sure
you're jumping in the right place. I will show this multiple times, so you know exactly when and where to jump.
While inside, my preferred method has always been fire magic. Simply stand back and blast spells until Coldra
finally dies and gives you the same drop you've gotten five times already. Well, this is RuneScape after all. Too
bad there's no Grand Exchange. Anyhow, I'll shut up now and let you guys watch it uninterrupted and unedited
to show you exactly how it's done. I truly appreciate this community >> [music]
>> and I appreciate you guys for watching. Until next time.
